title: File:Keshavnarayan Vishnu dol Joysagar 05.jpg
author: Nayan j Nath
description: The Keshavnarayan Vishnu dol, popularly known as Joy dol, was constructed in 1698 by Ahom king Swargadeo Rudra Singha (1696–1714) in honour and memory of his mother Joymoti . It is located at Joysagar, Sivasagar, Assam.
